verdict.rationale: Brex publishes a per-product API reference on developer.brex.com, including OpenAPI-derived pages such as webhooks_api.md, plus a quickstart for making a first call. Runnable exploration is documented only through Postman, an external app for testing calls without code, not a built-in interactive console. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-browser 'try it' console in the reference, runnable code samples embedded in the docs, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
